text.description_html:
Stainless Steel 5 x 2-1/2 Push Plate

Custom size 5" x 2.5" commercial door push plate. Primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories and stores. Made in the USA from .050" thick solid stainless steel. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation. This 5" x 2-1/2" Push Plate has a Satin (brushed) Stainless Steel Finish

Specifications of the 5" x 2-1/2" Stainless Steel Push Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Height: 5"
  • Plate Width: 2-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

Sold Individually. Made to order custom size. NOT Returnable.
